description: Questions for Recall@3. expected_text_contains is a verbatim span of the gold chunk. Objection questions are copied from the official objection-handling documents.

queries.question: What does executive and mid-management headhunting include?
What is the smallest customer support team a client can contract?
Does a corporate training program include a certificate?
How is the executive headhunting fee calculated?
queries.expected_text_contains: 22% of the hired role's gross annual salary

queries.question: What is the monthly fee for one outsourced support agent?
How much does an 8-week training program cost?
How long does an executive search usually take, and how large is the shortlist?
What should the consultant do if four weeks into an executive search no qualified candidate has been presented?
queries.expected_text_contains: escalate the case to Javier Almeida

queries.question: Do you guarantee a delivery time when the search is limited to one specific city?
22% seems expensive compared to other firms.
queries.expected_text_contains: 22% seems expensive compared to other firms.

queries.question: Can I pay everything at the end, once the candidate starts working?

queries.expected_text_contains: one additional round of search at no cost

queries.question: Do you work with companies in my same sector that are direct competitors?
¿Qué incluye el headhunting de mandos medios y directivos?
queries.expected_text_contains: por competencias, y verificación de referencias

queries.question: ¿Cuál es el tamaño mínimo de un equipo de soporte que puede contratar un cliente?
queries.expected_text_contains: Tamaño mínimo de equipo contratable: 5 agentes

queries.question: ¿Trabajan con empresas de mi mismo sector que sean competencia directa?
